segments.contextBefore: The following example creates a [`Regex`](regex.md) that matches a date formatted with the base ISO 8601 format.

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let iso860Source = "2022-07-14T21:10:15Z Lemon-lime slushie $1.99" let matcher = Regex { Capture { One(.iso8601) } OneOrMore(.horizontalWhitespace) OneOrMore(.any) OneOrMore(.horizontalWhitespace) One(.localizedCurrency(code:Locale.Currency("USD"), locale:Locale(identifier: "en_US"))) } let match = iso860Source.firstMatch(of: matcher) let date = match?.1 // date == Jul 14, 2022 at 2:10 PM PST ```
